issues.detail: The Greek text describes the action of 'entering the world' (διερχομενος εις τον κοσμον) as a participle modifying the subject (Jesus), but the Vietnamese translation renders it as a temporal clause ('khi vào thế gian') and incorrectly attributes the speech to Him as a quote ('Ngài phán').
The Greek 'ουκ ηθελησας' is 2nd person singular ('you did not want'), but the Vietnamese translates it as 3rd person ('Chúa chẳng muốn' - God/Lord did not want).
The Greek 'λεγει' (says) is missing or replaced by the implied speech structure in the Vietnamese.
